input, change and submit events

input fires as a user edits a value; change typically fires when a value is committed, depending on the
control; submit fires on a form submission that proceeds to that event.
Text field එක edit කරන හැම වාරයකම input event එක run Jවන්න පුළුවන්. change event එක value එක commit කරන Jවලාවට run Jවනවා. Form එක submit Jවද්දී submit handler එක භාවිත කරනවා.
